Prepare step by step

  1. Ask the care team to explain the written discharge instructions and who to contact with questions.
  2. Confirm follow-up appointments, transportation and which records need to move.
  3. Review medication changes with the care team or pharmacist.
  4. Use 911 or the care team's emergency instructions for urgent warning signs.

General care navigation and visit preparation only; no diagnosis, treatment, medication instruction, coverage decision or clinical interpretation.
